test_title: PYST 31: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that does NOT correctly complete the given sentence.

Online classes are useful because one ______.

options.text: has to take only one final examination
has more control over one’s learning
can study at one’s own pace
can easily clarify one’s doubts online

solution:
The correct answer is **"has to take only one final examination".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Online classes are useful because one has to take only one final examination is **incorrect statement **according to the passage. This statement **does not refer **in the passage.
 
• **According to the above passage the benefits of online courses are following :**
 
 
• has more control over one's learning,
 
• can study at one's own pace,
 
• can easily clarify one's doubts online,
 
• engaging multimedia content,
 
• greater access to the instructor, etc., are the major benefits to get the online education.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.
